question:
The mean proportional of 6 and 54 is _____ more than 15.

(CGL 2022 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e. 3.

Mean proportion of 6 and 54 
= \(\sqrt{6\ \times\ 54}\) 
= \(\sqrt{6\ \times\ 9\ \times\ 6}\)
= 3 × 6 = 18 
∴ 18 is 3 more than 15.
question_hi:

(CGL 2022 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 अर्थात 3 है।

6 और 54 का मध्यानुपात
= \(\sqrt{6\ \times\ 54}\) 
= \(\sqrt{6\ \times\ 9\ \times\ 6}\) 
= 3 × 6 = 18 
∴ 18, 15 से 3 अधिक है।

question:

(CGL 2022 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e. 81.

x = 27 × 3 = 81

question:
The third proportional of (x2 - y2) and (x - y) is :

(CGL 2023 Pre)
options:
(x - y)

\(\frac{x\ -\ y}{x\ +\ y}\)

\(\frac{x+\ y}{x-\ y}\)

(x + y)
solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. \(\frac{x\ -\ y}{x\ +\ y}\) .

3rd proportion of a, b = \(\frac{b^2}{a} \)
∴ \((x-y)^2\over x^2-y^2\)
\(\therefore\frac{\left(x\ -\ y\right)^2}{\left(x\ +\ y\right)\left(x\ -\ y\right)}\) 
=\(\frac{{x}\ -\ {y}}{{x}\ +\ {y}}\)

question:

108 = 54K

∴ A = K(B + 18)

A = 2 × 86 = 172

question:
If a : b : : b : c, and b = 96, then which of the following can be a possible pair of values of a and c?

(CGL 2023 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. a = 32; c = 288.

a : b = b : c 
a/b = b/c
b2 = ac
b = \(\sqrt{ac}\)
96 = \(\sqrt{ac}\)
Now go through options: a = 32, c = 288
\(\sqrt{ac}\ \)= \(\sqrt{32\ \times\ 288}\)
= \(\sqrt{16\ \times\ 2\ \times\ 36\times8}\) 
= 4 × 4 × 6 
= 96 
∴ a = 32
c = 288

a : b = b : c

b2 = ac

\(\sqrt{ac}\ \)= \(\sqrt{32\ \times\ 288}\)
= \(\sqrt{16\ \times\ 2\ \times\ 36\times8}\) 
= 4 × 4 × 6 
= 96 
∴ a = 32
c = 288

question:
If x varies inversely as y and x = 2 when y = 6, then the value of y when x = 3 is:

(CGL 2024 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. 4.

x ∝ \(\frac{1}{y}\) 
x =\(\frac{k}{y}\)     where (K = constant) 
now, put x = 2 , y = 6 
2 = \(\frac{K}{6}\), K = 12 
Again,
x = \(\frac{K}{y}\)  (put x = 3)
3 = \(\frac{12}{y}\) ⇒ y = 4
question_hi:
यदि x, y के व्युत्क्रमानुपाती है तथा y = 6 होने पर x = 2 होता है, तो x = 3 होने पर y का मान क्या होगा?

(CGL 2024 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 अर्थात 4 है।

x ∝ \(\frac{1}{y}\) 
x = \(\frac{k}{y}\)     जहाँ (K = स्थिरांक) 
अब, x = 2 , y = 6 रखें
2 = \(\frac{K}{6}\), K = 12 
पुन:,
x = \(\frac{K}{y}\)  (x = 3 रखें)
3 = \(\frac{12}{y}\)⇒ y = 4

question:
What is the ratio of the mean proportional of 1.21 and 0.09 to the mean proportional of 0.16 and 0.36?

(CGL 2024 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e. 11 : 8.

Mean proportional of 1.21 and 0.09 = \(\sqrt{1.21\ \times\ 0.09}\)

= 1.1 × 0.3 = 0.33 

Mean proportional of 0.16 and 0.36 = \(\sqrt{0.16\ \times\ 0.36}\)

= 0.4 × 0.6 

= 0.24 

Required ratio = 0.33 : 0.24 = 11 : 8
question_hi:

(CGL 2024 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 अर्थात 11 : 8 है।

1.21 और 0.09 का मध्यानुपात = \(\sqrt{1.21\ \times\ 0.09}\) 

= 1.1 × 0.3 = 0.33 

0.16 और 0.36 का मध्यानुपात = \(\sqrt{0.16\ \times\ 0.36}\)

= 0.4 × 0.6

= 0.24

आवश्यक अनुपात = 0.33 : 0.24 = 11 : 8

question:
If a \(\propto b, b \propto\frac{1}{c}\) and \(c \propto d\) then the relation between a and d is:

(CPO 2023 Pre)
options:
\(a \propto\frac{1}{d}\)

\(a \propto d\)

\(a \propto d^2\)

\(a \propto\sqrt d\)
solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e. \(a \propto\frac{1}{d}\).

a ∝ b ⇒ a = kb .......(i)

b ∝ \(\frac{1}{c}\) ⇒ b = \(\frac{k}{c}\).......(ii)

c ∝ d ⇒ c = kd .......(iii)

from (i) and (ii)

a = kb ⇒ a = k × \(\frac{k}{c}\)

a = \(\frac{k^2}{c}\) .......(iv)

from (iii) and (iv) 

a= \(\frac{k^2}{c}\Rightarrow\ \ a\) = \(\frac{k^2}{kd}\)

a = \(\frac{k}{d}\Rightarrow\ \mathbf{a}\ \propto\frac{\mathbf{1}}{\mathbf{d}}\)

c ∝ d ⇒ c = kd .......(iii)

(i) और (ii) से

a = kb ⇒ a = k × \(\frac{k}{c}\)

a = \(\frac{k^2}{c}\) .......(iv)

(iii) और (iv) से

a= \(\frac{k^2}{c}\Rightarrow\ \ a\) = \(\frac{k^2}{kd}\)

a = \(\frac{k}{d}\Rightarrow\ \mathbf{a}\ \propto\frac{\mathbf{1}}{\mathbf{d}}\)

question:
When P is subtracted from each of the numbers 8, 6, 2 and 9, the numbers so obtained in this order are in proportion. What is the mean proportional between (3P-6) and (9P-4)?

(CHSL 2023 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. 28.

According to the question  
\(\frac{8\ -\ P}{6\ -\ P}=\frac{2\ -\ P}{9\ -\ P}\)

⇒ (8 - P)(9 - P) = (2 - P)(6 - P)

⇒ 72 - 8P - 9P + P2 =12 - 2P - 6P + P2

⇒ 72 - 17P = 12 - 8P 

⇒ 60 = 9P 

P =\(\frac{60}{9}=\frac{20}{3}\)

∴ Mean proportional between (3P - 6) and (9P - 4) = \(\sqrt{(3P-6)(9P-4)}\)
⇒ \(\sqrt{\left(3 \times \frac{20}{3} - 6\right)\left(9 \times \frac{20}{3} - 4\right)}\)

⇒ \(\sqrt{14\times\ 56}\)

⇒\(\sqrt{14\ \times\ 14\ \times\ 4}\)

⇒ 14 × 2 = 28
question_hi:
जब P को प्रत्येक संख्या 8, 6, 2 और 9 में से घटाया जाता है, तो इस क्रम में इस प्रकार प्राप्त संख्याएँ समानुपात में होती हैं। (3P-6) और (9P-4) के बीच का मध्यानुपात क्या है?

(CHSL 2023 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 अर्थात 28 है।

प्रश्न के अनुसार
\(\frac{8\ -\ P}{6\ -\ P}=\frac{2\ -\ P}{9\ -\ P}\)

⇒ (8 - P)(9 - P) = (2 - P)(6 - P)

⇒ 72 - 8P - 9P + P2 =12 - 2P - 6P + P2

⇒ 72 - 17P = 12 - 8P 

⇒ 60 = 9P 

P =\(\frac{60}{9}=\frac{20}{3}\)
∴ (3P-6) और (9P - 4) के बीच मध्यानुपात = \(\sqrt{(3P-6)(9P-4)}\)

⇒ \(\sqrt{\left(3 \times \frac{20}{3} - 6\right)\left(9 \times \frac{20}{3} - 4\right)}\)

⇒ \(\sqrt{14\times\ 56}\)

⇒\(\sqrt{14\ \times\ 14\ \times\ 4}\)

⇒ 14 × 2 = 28

question:
What number must be added to each of the numbers 7, 4, 4 and 2 so that the resulting numbers may be in proportion?  

(MTS 2020 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e. 2.

(7 + x)/(4 + x) = (4 + x)/(2 + x) 

⇒ 14 + 9x + x2 = x2+ 16 + 8x

⇒ x = 2

question:
Find the fourth proportional of (x4 - y4), (x + y) and (x - y), provided x \(\neq\) y.

(SP 2023 Phase - 11 Graduation L.)
solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e. (x2 + y2)-1.

4th proportional of a, b, c = \(\frac{bc}{a}\) 
⇒ \(\frac{(x + y)(x - y)}{x^4 - y^4}\)
= \(\frac{(x + y)(x - y)}{(x^2 - y^2)(x^2 + y^2)}\)
= \(\frac{(x + y)(x - y)}{(x + y)(x - y)(x^2 + y^2)}\)
= \(\frac{1}{x^2+\ y^2}\)
= \(\left(\mathbf{x}^\mathbf{2}+\ \mathbf{y}^\mathbf{2}\right)^{-\mathbf{1}}\)

question:
Three numbers are given as \(\frac{1}{4}\) of 28, \(\frac{2}{3}\) of 18 and \(\frac{2}{5}\) of 35. What is the fourth proportional of these numbers?

(SP 2023 Phase - 11 Graduation L.)
solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. 24.

I = \(\frac{1}{4}\times28\) = 7
II = \(\frac{2}{3}\times 18\) = 12
III =\( \frac{2}{5}\times\ 35\) = 14
4th proportional = \(\frac{14\ \times\ 12}{7}\) = 24

(SP 2023 Phase - 11 Graduation L.)
solution_hi:

III =\( \frac{2}{5}\times\ 35\) = 14

question:
The mean proportional between \((3 +\sqrt5)\) and \((15 +\sqrt{125})\) is:

(SP 2023 Phase - 11 Matric. L.)
solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e. \(3\sqrt5 +5\).

Mean proportional of a, b = \(\sqrt{ab}\)
= \(\sqrt{\left(3\ +\ \sqrt5\right)\left(15\ +\ \sqrt{125}\right)}\)
=\(\ \sqrt{\left(3\ +\ \sqrt5\right)\left(15\ +\ 5\sqrt5\right)} \)
=\(\ \sqrt{45\ +\ 15\sqrt5+\ 15\sqrt5+\ 25} \)
=\(\ \sqrt{70\ +\ 30\sqrt5} \)
=\(\sqrt{{(3\sqrt5}+5)^2}\)
= 3√5 + 5
